sampling_rule: Confidence bounds are conditional on an independently reviewed probability sampling design and independent connected groups. Authored challenges and public retrospective data do not establish population error rates.
threshold_rule: Numbers are prospective engineering acceptance choices, not linguistic theorems or measured V14 achievements. Version and freeze changes before opening a new assessment.
training_rule: Group all descendants before splitting; use only train/calibration for optimization, gate selection and early stopping. Replay eligible prior tasks and retain the original full target inventory. Twenty/five groups are intake floors, not sufficiency or sample-size guarantees.
stop_rule: A semantic certificate, reference adequacy, independent sampling attestation and external-world evidence cannot be supplied by a model status or a metric. Missing owner adapters keep licensed completion NOT_MEASURED.
